utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the repair drive’s coming up soon, and it sounds like a good turnout already. If you hear any update, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, it’s coming up soon? Are we sure the turnout is already looking good?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s what I heard—nothing firm yet, but a few folks already said they’d swing by. If I hear anything more definite, I’ll tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and tell a few neighbors about it, so they don’t miss out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—good idea. I might miss the flyer, so thanks for telling me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem—I’ll mention it to a few more neighbors too, so word gets around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what time should I bring it by?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Anytime after 4 works fine—just swing by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring it by after 4.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard all the details yet, but I’m glad to help if you’re organizing the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’ll start a supplies list and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a huge help, Faye — I’m still pinning down the exact time, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set. If you can help spread the word and keep an eye on school conflicts, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and watch for any school conflicts. Just send me the time as soon as you have it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Let’s keep it simple: tell me what’s needed, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Eli—let’s keep it simple indeed. I’ll write down what we need and bring it over so you can follow along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good plan, Oren. Bring it over when you’re ready, and I’ll take it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m putting together a little repair drive and would love for you to come by. If you’re free, I’ll send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds helpful, but I’ll need the details first so I can check the time and where to go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the time, place, and what we’re fixing so you can see if it works for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the full details yet—what’s the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s a neighborhood effort to help folks get small repairs done—things like leaky faucets, loose steps, or broken fixtures. I’m still gathering names and needs, so if you know anyone who could use a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anyone who mentions a fix-up need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details one more time? I want to make sure I get everything right before I act.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 2. Bring any small appliances, bikes, or household items that need fixing, and we’ll try to help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ve got it: this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 2, and people can bring small appliances, bikes, or household items. I’ll pass that along carefully.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Totally fair — I can keep it quiet. If you can spare even a small hand, I’ll make sure it’s low-key.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you have a hammer, a Phillips screwdriver, and maybe a tape measure?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got all three and I can bring them by. Just point me to where you want them dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where the repair drive is happening. Do you know the exact location or should I look it up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t have the exact spot on me—can you look it up? Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, I’ll look it up and keep track of it for us.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got some tools I can lend for the repair drive. Tell me what you need, and I’ll see if I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: What are you fixing up first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to confirm the timing and drop-off details first. Do you know when the repair drive starts and where we should bring everything?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—can you confirm the start time and drop-off spot before we go?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check, but I’ll need the start time and drop-off spot before I can plan my route.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Jules—could you help line up a few volunteers and spread the word about what items folks can bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I can reach out to a few volunteers and put together a quick note about accepted items. If you have any flyer details or a preferred place to share it, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand and see what’s still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be great — I’ll swing by a little later and help with whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll make a quick list and set aside anything we already have. When you come by, we can fill in the gaps together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout already. I can pass along the details if you want!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great, thanks. Please send me the details and I’ll see what we can do around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just give me the key details for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — we’re meeting Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community shed, and we’ll sort tools, materials, and pickup routes from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ve got it. I’ll be there Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you handle the tool drop-off and keep an eye on the sign-up sheet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ve got it — I’ll handle the tool drop-off and keep an eye on the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about it — the repair drive could use all the hands it can get. Want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, put my name down — just let me know what time to show up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the time and send it over as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where’s the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s happening over at the community center parking lot by Oak Street. I can walk you through the plan if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, great — the community center parking lot by Oak Street. Yes, please walk me through the plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are you still coordinating the repair drive? I can help if you need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina, yes — I’m still coordinating it. I’m just double-checking the repair list and timing before I ask for help, but I may need you for a specific task soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Of course — just let me know what task you need me to handle. I’m happy to help once you’ve got the list and timing sorted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know what I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’d really appreciate that. I’ll keep my eyes open too and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, so if I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll pass it along.
